targets.coverage: Noether Paper 07, Der Endlichkeitssatz der Invarianten endlicher Gruppen, printed pp.89-92. Package reports content largely present at checked formula anchors, but the cumulative edition is not source-faithful in its footnote apparatus: source pages use page-local symbolic notes *) and **), while current cumulative TeX uses ordinary numbered footnotes for all six P07 notes. It records checked no-fix anchors for the Galois resolvent display and Weber II, section 58 derivative correction formula.
